external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: People who sign in through the identity broker and use applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who are vouched for by their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: It is not documented which franchise colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated by the franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The provider's allowed population is not documented.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies colleague group-membership changes and leaver changes overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.
external_entities.notes: Its location and security properties are not documented.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates franchise identity-provider sign-in, and supplies public signing material to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The broker does not call back to determine whether a colleague is still allowed in. Second-factor use is not documented.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses token group membership to let a holder change prices and void transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store containing the signing key used by the identity broker for tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership is supplied by the HR system overnight. Encryption at rest is not documented.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. Encryption at rest is not documented.

data_flows.name: colleagues sign in to identity broker
data_flows.description: Colleagues initiate sign-in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are

data_flows.name: identity broker issues token to colleagues
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token containing a colleague's staff id and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: Tokens are valid for twelve hours and cannot be pulled back before expiry.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and group list

data_flows.name: colleagues use store admin console
data_flows.description: Colleagues present their token to the store admin console and use it to change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: A store-manager token works against every store because the console does not check store membership.
data_flows.data_description: Token, price changes, and transaction void requests

data_flows.name: store admin console fetches public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the token-signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the token-signing key

data_flows.name: HR system supplies overnight changes to identity broker
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies group-membership and leaver changes to the identity broker overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues and the identity broker accepts that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: It is not documented which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: identity broker uses signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker uses the signing key kept in the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.notes: The same key signs tokens for every application.

data_flows.name: identity broker maintains directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory of colleagues and group memberships, including overnight changes from the HR system.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: identity broker writes sign-ins to audit log
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: It is not documented what the log records or whether franchise sign-ins are included.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which the identity broker and store admin console run, and the apparent internal zone containing the broker's stores.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: colleagues' own devices
trust_boundaries.description: Devices used by colleagues at home to sign in to the identity broker.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled zone containing franchise colleagues and their identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it contains the token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store contains a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it contains colleague staff identities and group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The HR system is in the corporate network zone for purposes of assigning the required trust zone.
assumptions.basis: The source names the HR system as the internal source of colleague group-membership and leaver changes but does not state its location; the corporate network is the only stated internal zone.
